verify.title: Round {round}: was it fair?
verify.okDetail: Your browser just recomputed the draw from scratch and got exactly these people.
verify.badDetail: The commitment or the result does not match the published data.
verify.stepCommitment: The SHA-256 of the seed matches the commitment published before the spin
verify.stepWinners: Recomputing {n} of {total} candidates gives the same result
verify.how: How: sort the candidates by id; for pick i, take the first 8 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(seed, "drawId:i") modulo the number of people left, and take the person at that position. The server cannot change the seed once the commitment is published.
